implementation: Implemented a read-only Governance Steward mode that accepts complete evaluation bundles and emits content-addressed Prompt, Model or Strategy ChangeProposal facts. Evaluation outcomes constrain adoption, rejection, additional evaluation and rollback proposals, while all registry and activation actions remain independent human-governed steps.

tests.targeted_result: 8 passed (6 V5-007 plus 2 V4 governance regressions)
tests.v5_regression: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fao-uv-cache uv run pytest tests/contract/test_v5_001_tick_replay.py tests/contract/test_v5_002_order_book.py tests/contract/test_v5_003_paper_adapter.py tests/contract/test_v5_004_algorithms.py tests/contract/test_v5_005_exposure.py tests/contract/test_v5_006_calibration.py tests/contract/test_v5_007_governance_steward.py -q
tests.full_gate_result: lock, format, ruff, mypy over 166 source files, secret scan, 2 schema, 1 unit, 18 property, 895 contract, and health passed

acceptance_mapping.evaluation_only: Every bundle must cover quality, boundary compliance, regression, cost/latency and rollback readiness in canonical order with unique evidence references.
acceptance_mapping.closed_targets: StewardSubjectKind contains only PROMPT, MODEL and STRATEGY; Risk Policy is not a constructible target.
acceptance_mapping.outcome_consistency: ADOPT requires all PASS, REJECT/ROLLBACK requires FAIL, and RUN_MORE_EVALUATION requires UNKNOWN.
acceptance_mapping.proposal_only: ChangeProposal contains evidence, risk, rationale and required governance steps but no approval, merge, activation or registry mutation state.
acceptance_mapping.no_authority: GovernanceSteward exposes only read/query tools and no merge, promote, activate, rollback, modify-risk or write-registry operation.
acceptance_mapping.separation: Every proposal requires human change approval, independent Registry action, independent Activation and rollback planning.

limitations: V5-008 owns shadow/canary execution and activation lifecycle; this task only proposes changes.
The Steward cannot modify Risk Constitution, trading truth, registry state or active traffic.
model_output_not_authoritative: Evaluation contracts and independent governance services, not Steward text, decide any state change.
